title: Curtain up
description: The Glass Widow opens to a full house.

title: Raised voices in Dressing Room 1
description: In the interval, Cordelia Vane collects her gown from Crane's room. Wardrobe hears shouting.

title: Act 2 begins
description: Crane and Vane on stage together.

title: Crane's last exit
description: Crane's character dies. He walks off to his dressing room to wait for the curtain call.

title: The pass-door key goes out
description: Someone signs the pass-door key out from the front-of-house board.

title: Box B door opens
description: The usher notes a gentleman stepping out of Box B.

title: Felix leaves by the stage door
description: The understudy goes out of the stage door.

title: The prompt corner changes hands
description: The assistant calls four cues while the stage manager is away.

title: Tea left outside Crane's door
description: The dresser leaves a tray outside Dressing Room 1.

title: Box B door closes
description: The gentleman returns to Box B.

title: Crane found dead
description: He misses the curtain call. The stage manager goes to fetch him and finds him on the floor.
